look: Silk and light: Translucent fabric ribbons and glowing particles, everything weightless and flowing. Tone: ethereal, romantic, breathless. Original characters: a pale figure in loose white robes and a long-haired rescuer in crimson.

scenes.name: Sinking
scenes.desc: The white-robed figure drifts down through churning blue, robes billowing, eyes closing.

scenes.name: Crimson streak
scenes.desc: A crimson streak cuts the dark, butterflies scatter, and the rescuer catches the sinking figure by the waist.

scenes.name: Held close
scenes.desc: Close-up: eyes snap open as the rescuer pulls them flush, fierce and protective.

scenes.name: The transfer
scenes.desc: The rescuer leans in; silver-blue light blooms from the kiss and lights the water.

scenes.name: Rising spiral
scenes.desc: The camera circles the pair as bubbles and silver butterflies spiral up, pushing the dark away.

scenes.name: One butterfly
scenes.desc: Hands rest on shoulders, cut to black, a single silver butterfly crosses the screen.
